Marginal note in the right margin beside the first lines of the second paragraph ("Casus 48"). Catchword "nem" at the right below the text, with gathering signature "O" at the foot.

main_text.p: quantum & quatenus & quo sensu in-tendebat se obligare. Ast ubi contra promissio ipsa fundatur in debito aliquo antecedente; debito sc. aut subjectionis & obsequii ex authoritate superioris, aut justitiæ & pacti ex conventione partium: quia is cui fit promissio jus habet eam exigendi, & ipsius maxime interest ut promissi fides servetur: ratio postulat ut ex ipsius potius mente & interpretatione, quàm ex promittentis sensu, de promissionis obligatione judicetur.
main_text.head: SECT. X.
main_text.p: Casus Tertius est, ubi deferens jura-Casus 48mentum sensus ambigui, id tantum po-stulat ut in ea verba juretur; permittit interim jurantis ipsius arbitrio, quocunq; voluerit sensu juramenti verba intelligere. Dico, merito f[?] spectum esse debere latentis alicujus doli mali, & pro-inde recusandum esse viro pio & prudenti oblatum sub tali conditione juramentum: quod mihi videtur triplici de causa improbandum. Primo, respe-ctu ipsius Juramenti, in quo requiritur imprimis veritas: oratio autem indefiniti & ambigui sensus ante distinctio-

page.notes: Right margin note "Casus 48" placed beside the line "jura-mentum". Left margin has only faint marks at line starts (edge/show-through), not transcribed. "f[?] spectum" is uncertain: the letter before "spectum" is unclear and may be a stray long s. Line-end hyphens kept as printed. The "ct" in "Prælectio" and "Præleētio" is a ligature in print; written as "ct". Words with long s were normalised to plain s, and "fe" and "fi" are written as "se" and "si".
